title: Integrating Hydra Scaling into Cardano Kuber Library

ms.promise: Detailed project plan, timeline, and technical design specifications for integrating Hydra transaction support into the Kuber Library.
ms.criteria:
・Project plan is published on Github repository either as one or more issues or Markdown document.
・Project plan should include:
・Scope of integration
・List of APIs/JSON RPC to implement:
・Query API
・query Utxos (by address)
・query Utxos ( by txIn)
・query tip
・query protocol parameter
・query hydra state (utxo commiting, ready, fanout, closed)
・Transaction Build API supporting the kuber transaction spec
・Hydra Relay API
・Head initialization,
・Committing UTxOs
・Decommitting
・Head Closing
・Fanout Transaction
・Aborting
・Timeline
・Risks and issues identified
・Github issues for individual APIs to be

ms.promise:
Implementation of the Hydra Head management functionalities on Kuber:
・Head initialization, committing/decommitting UTxOs, aborting, querying UTxOs, and checking commit status.
・Raw transaction building, signing, and submission.
・Close, contestation, and fanout actions.
・Test coverage for all implemented features mentioned above.
ms.criteria:
・Updated Kuber library codebase (https://github.com/dquadrant/kuber)
・Test results published on the repository either as issue or markdown file. 
・Implementation tests are successful.
ms.report:

Client libraries
We had to make changes in client libraries, and release updates on them:
- Updated base library of kuber-client: libcardano-wallet 
 Version: v2.2.13, Link: https://www.npmjs.com/package/libcardano-wallet/v/2.2.13
- Update kuber-client
 Version: v3.3.5, Link: https://www.npmjs.com/package/kuber-client/v/3.3.5

Tutorials

- https://dquadrant.github.io/kuber/hydra_docusaurus/docs/hydra-js-client/getting-started/

Test Results (updated)
